description: Centres de Secours et d'Intervention dans le département d'Eure-et-Loir is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CD28. Geolocation of Relief and Intervention Centres in the department of Eure-et-Loir according to the following types: DDSIS: Departmental Directorate of Fire and Rescue Services CSP: Main Relief Centre CS: Rescue Centre HERE: Intervention Centre. Coverage: CD28. The portal shows the English title as "Rescue and Intervention Centres in the department of Eure-et-Loir" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CD28. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, CSV, SHP. The listing shows 2025-02-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
